title: The recomp/decomp/ai slop 'discourse' on Reddit is just unbelievably dumb
author: freedomfromfreedom
selftext:
Ai is the best thing to ever happen to indie game dev, modding community and cross platform compatibility. A high-end Mac is now a PS5, a Switch and a PC rolled into one with no flakey emulation, just beautiful modern silicon running native code, and highly portable with far less heat and wattage than a console or PC. The modding community now can go much further and practically rebuild the entire game engine in place of the original, on any kind of hardware...

Yet 90% of the discussion about all this is exactly like the anti 'ai slop' agenda of the public - naive, misinformed, and needlessly hostile.

These folk have a total miscomprehension of what actually it is and what's going on. Also, those pumping out buggy recomps and ai slop are just as bad as they are - talentless hacks - they all need to go silent, take a breather and use this amazing technology to the full extent and get creative.

People one-shotting a recomp then uploading the entire C code to Github will bring the hammer down on the rest of us. It isn't legal to publish the full recomp or derived code. You should only open source the tools.

People whining about recomps that clearly are more than a straight port. Mods and APIs built on the original game, with amazing new features, art and game mechanics, new 3D engines even. This is not a recomp, it's far more.

Just because the base game is recompiled from the game.exe does not give these idiots a license to belittle what's built on top, that takes months of effort and REAL skill and talent to mod a game engine. Claude won't one shot this, not now, not ever.

People misunderstanding the difference between recomp and decomp... Even a kid can understand this after 1 minute of research. A recomp is machine code from the binary -> incomprehensible C, millions of lines of machine code translated to C that can only be understood by the AI - and even then, not completely - maybe about 10% max. A decomp is a FULL reimplementation of **every single function** in the original source code, in C++ (not C, fully object orientated) or another modern language like Swift, with comments and an optimised structure. Nobody is able to do that yet with a PS5 game... even with their six concurrent max 20x Opus 5.5 or whatever these shills use to pump out their crap.

Clean room... Art Craft and stuff is supposed to be a clone, it's very debatable where it draws the line between recomp, stealing from other open source apps, and implementing original code. All the hype and clickbait content ignores this. It's a real grey area, and to be honest I don't trust it to work properly at all beyond just surface level. Decoding RAW files from over 8000 digital cameras from different brands with different sensors and colour profiles, Adobe DCP pipelines and internal processing chains, colour matching, and these are just the BASICS that pro use of Lightroom needs. There's not a chance in hell Craftslop works the same as the original software for enterprise or anything beyond surface level use.  
  
And why is there ALWAYS an expectation that you release software free and open source? Why does everything ALWAYS have to be free? How are the rest of us who don't want to act as a charity or pirate supposed to pay the rent?

People whinging about AI slop are the same ones moaning about modders charging $10 on steam for something incredibly good that took talent and hard work to make.

On AI slop... Sick of people blaming the tool. The bad worker blames his tool has never been more true. It's the human that makes the decisions - the human that decides to rush it out, the human that feels slop is 'good enough', the human that releases it, the human that one shots the UI with Claude without even bothering to take out the Claude-speak and long text explainers... and the human that doesn't bother to spend time iterating on something. THEY lack the vision... Stop blaming the AI.

Please somebody shut off these slop dwellers, whingers, moaners and bots from our communities. I am so tired of having to scroll past their misinformed BS opinions just to get to the good stuff!!

It’s totally against the law and if you get found out you will get sued.  It’s not super complicated why artists don’t like AI companies because of misuse and unlicensed use of products. People here defending billionaire ai companies so cringe

The first time ChatGPT could generate images you would write a prompt and you could go find the exact image on art station or close enough with tiny changes. Unlicensed use of some poor ass artist by a billionaire company to build AI that can reproduce an artist images.

comments.author: ConsistentAnalysis35
comments.body:
> People whining about recomps that clearly are more than a straight port. Mods and APIs built on the original game, with amazing new features, art and game mechanics, new 3D engines even. This is not a recomp, it's far more.

This is just sad. As a modder, yes those new 3D engines are complete slop, those amazing new features are unpolished slop 90% of the time.
